adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Jobs::PollFeed` which does `require 'open-uri'` and then calls `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` (poll_feed.rb). Using `open` on a string is dangerous because `Kernel#open` treats values starting with `|` as a shell command (pipe), so a malicious `feed_polling_url` site setting could trigger command execution in the Sidekiq process. This is a concrete security issue introduced by the new feed polling feature and its new admin-controlled setting (`config/site_settings.yml`).
